text:
maya: quick heads-up — our pricing experiment rollout to cohort-B (variant v2-ratecard) is showing ~3x invoice line items for a small set of accounts in EU-west. seeing this in both metered and reserved customers :eyes:
ben: Ugh. do we have a query to show which accounts and what the extra lines are?
maya: yes, here's the ad-hoc query I ran against billing_events (ran at 10:18 UTC):
```sql
SELECT account_id, event_type, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(amount_usd)
FROM billing_events
WHERE price_variant = 'v2-ratecard'
  AND region = 'eu-west'
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY account_id, event_type
ORDER BY SUM(amount_usd) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
maya: top offenders look like 5 accounts where a single API usage burst was split into multiple invoice lines after the price switch — suspect double-metering on our vendor side or an event dedupe bug. sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xy-example
liam: are these all in the same time window? could be a retry/ingest duplication from the edge.
sara: tagging ops-bot to check ingest pipeline latency/errors for that window -> @ops-bot please run the dedupe check for 2026-03-20 09:30-10:30 UTC
ops-bot: received. running dedupe check for events with request_id collisions in 2026-03-20 09:00-11:00 UTC. will report in ~3m.
ben: if vendor double-billed us (we pass through vendor metering to customers) we may need to issue credits. Preference is: 1) quick canary rollback for cohort-B to v1-pricing, 2) issue immediate pro-rated credits for affected accounts, 3) deeper postmortem.
maya: +1 on rollback if we confirm vendor/ingest duplication. can we flip cohort routing? what's the kill-switch?
liam: product flag is `pricing_cohort_router.v2_ratecard_enabled`. ops can toggle via Console -> Feature Flags -> cohort-router. I can do it if we agree.
sara: we need sign-off from finance for credits before rollback? legal might care. maya, ben — can you approve emergency credits up to $5k per account immediate exec action?
ben: I approve up to $5k/account for immediate credits pending final reconciliation. larger cases escalate to finance leadership. :white_check_mark:
maya: ok I'll start drafting the credit memo and notify support to hold off automated dunning for those accounts. can ops schedule the rollback at 10:35 UTC?
liam: I can flip the flag now and follow up with a validation query. prepping the change in 2m.
ops-bot: dedupe check complete. found 1.9k events with duplicated request_id across ingestion shard-3 between 09:40-09:55 UTC. probable root cause: transient reconnect to vendor webhook endpoint -> duplicate retries. attaching digest: /var/logs/ingest/dedupe-2032109876.log
maya: thanks — that matches the accounts in the sheet. okay proceed with rollback and issue interim credits.
liam: flipped `pricing_cohort_router.v2_ratecard_enabled` -> false at 2026-03-20T10:35:12Z. verifying...
liam: smoke-check: 
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_routing WHERE variant = 'v2-ratecard' AND region='eu-west';
```
liam: result 0. routing back to v1-pricing. :thumbsup:
ben: billing ops — please create refund/credit memos for the 5 highest accounts now, and a bulk credit batch for the rest. tag me on tickets. sample memo text in sheet.
sara: created ticket FIN-4621 for bulk credit batch, and FIN-4622..FIN-4626 for top accounts. assigning to @ben.
ben: assigned, will start issuing credits. estimated completion 45m. will send PR into billing system when done.
maya: putting temporary note on experiment: "paused — vendor dedupe issue caused duplicate invoice lines in eu-west; rollback applied 10:35 UTC. credits in process." adding to experiment dashboard.
liam: can we add a quick guard in ingest to dedupe same request_id within 10m window? ops-bot — can you open an infra ticket?
ops-bot: created INF-3319: "ingest: dedupe same request_id window (10m)" assigned to eng-infra. link: https://b.internal/INF-3319
ben: quick ask for finance: after credits, we should run a one-off reconciliation to validate net revenue delta for the cohort vs expected. maya, can you own that?
maya: I will run reconciliation and share results in this thread by EOD. putting a postmortem on cadence. thanks all for fast responses. :raised_hands:
liam: +1. follow-up: add vendor to incident cc list and request explanation. I'll loop in vendor-ops.
sara: noted. closing the immediate action items: rollback done, tickets created, credits authorized. leave thread open until reconciliation posted.
ben: thanks — tagging @finance-leads for visibility. :bell:
maya: final note — if anyone sees unexpected billing alerts tonight, ping this thread.
ops-bot: archival reminder: this thread will be auto-archived in 90 days.
